title: extract_list_id parses full 25 MiB message to find one header
description: routing::extract_list_id calls MessageParser::default().parse(raw_message) which parses the entire message including body. Called once per accepted DATA in session.rs to decide the Sieve-vs-queue routing path. With max_message_bytes = 25 MiB, every message triggers a 25 MiB parse to find a single header. Expected impact at scale: 100 simultaneous DATA sessions × 25 MiB × parse overhead = O(GiB) of transient work. Fix: hand-parse only the header section — scan bytes until blank line (CRLF CRLF), search for 'List-Id:' case-insensitively. Avoids body allocation entirely and reduces latency.
